recipes.oracle_text:
Return target creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Recover {2}{B} (When a creature is put into your graveyard from the battlefield, you may pay {2}{B}. If you do, return this card from your graveyard to your hand. Otherwise, exile this card.)

recipe_coverage: Oracle-reviewed single-card recovery: eligible alternatives and full-zone indices, type/color/value restrictions, graveyard ownership, exact/insufficient mana, empty zone, ordered unaffected zones, target departure and index shift through a real Reclaim response, populated-zone snapshot replay. Reanimation also checks entry characteristics and subsequent death ownership; subtype bonuses are explicit. Multi-target recovery, graveyard shroud, replacement effects, and exceptional card types remain separate. This declaration tests the normal hand-cast recovery component; Recover remains separate.
